class MyScanner {
private:
    static const int BUF_SIZE = 2048;
    FILE* br;
    char buf[BUF_SIZE];
    int bufPos, bufLen;
    
    void fillBuffer() {
        bufLen = fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, br);
        bufPos = 0;
    }
    
public:
    MyScanner() : br(stdin), bufPos(0), bufLen(0) {}
    
    bool isSpace(char c) {
        return c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == ' ';
    }
    
    string next() {
        string res = "";
        int c;
        while ((c = getChar()) != EOF && isSpace((char)c));
        if (c == EOF) return "";
        
        res += (char)c;
        while ((c = getChar()) != EOF && !isSpace((char)c)) {
            res += (char)c;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }
    
private:
    int getChar() {
        if (bufPos >= bufLen) {
            fillBuffer();
            if (bufLen == 0) return EOF;
        }
        return buf[bufPos++];
    }
};

class Reader {
private:
    FILE* br;
    string line;
    vector<string> tokens;
    int tokenIndex;
    
public:
    Reader() : br(stdin), tokenIndex(0) {}
    
    string next() {
        if (tokenIndex >= tokens.size()) {
            if (!getline(br, line)) return "";
            tokens.clear();
            istringstream iss(line);
            string token;
            while (iss >> token) {
                tokens.push_back(token);
            }
            tokenIndex = 0;
        }
        return tokens[tokenIndex++];
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }
    
    string nextLine() {
        string str = "";
        if (getline(br, str)) {
            return str;
        }
        return str;
    }
};

ll power(ll x, ll y, ll m) {
    if (y == 0) return 1;

}

bool* prime(int num) {
    bool* boolArr = new bool[num];
    for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
        boolArr[i] = true;
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(num); i++) {
        if (boolArr[i] == true) {
            for (int j = i * i; j < num; j = j + i) {
                boolArr[j] = false;
            }
        }
    }
    if (num >= 0) {
        boolArr[0] = false;
        boolArr[1] = false;
    }
    return boolArr;
}

class Combinations {
private:
    vector<long long> z;
    vector<long long> z1;
    vector<long long> z2;
    long long mod;
    
public:
    Combinations(long long N, long long mod) : mod(mod) {
        z.resize(N + 1);
        z1.resize(N + 1);
        z2.resize(N + 1);
        z[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            z[i] = (z[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }
        z2[0] = z2[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++) {
            z2[i] = z2[mod % i] * (mod - mod / i) % mod;
        }
        z1[0] = z1[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++) {
            z1[i] = (z2[i] * z1[i - 1]) % mod;
        }
    }
    
    long long fac(long long n) {
        return z[n];
    }
    
    long long invrsNum(long long n) {
        return z2[n];
    }
    
    long long invrsFac(long long n) {
        return invrsFac(n);
    }
    
    long long ncr(long long N, long long R) {
        if (R < 0 || R > N) return 0;
        long long ans = ((z[N] * z1[R]) % mod * z1[N - R]) % mod;
        return ans;
    }
};

class DisjointUnionSets {
private:
    vector<int> rank, parent;
    int n;
    
public:
    DisjointUnionSets(int n) : n(n) {
        rank.resize(n);
        parent.resize(n);
        makeSet();
    }
    
    void makeSet() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            parent[i] = i;
        }
    }
    
    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) {
            parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        }
        return parent[x];
    }
    
    void unionSets(int x, int y) {
        int xRoot = find(x), yRoot = find(y);
        if (xRoot == yRoot) return;
        
        if (rank[xRoot] < rank[yRoot]) {
            parent[xRoot] = yRoot;
        } else if (rank[yRoot] < rank[xRoot]) {
            parent[yRoot] = xRoot;
        } else {
            parent[yRoot] = xRoot;
            rank[xRoot] = rank[xRoot] + 1;
        }
    }
};

vector<int> KMP(string str) {
    int n = str.length();
    vector<int> kmp(n, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = kmp[i - 1];
        while (j > 0 && str[i] != str[j]) {
            j = kmp[j - 1];
        }
        if (str[i] == str[j]) j++;
        kmp[i] = j;
    }
    return kmp;
}

class SparseTable {
private:
    vector<vector<long long>> st;
    vector<int> log;
    
public:
    SparseTable(vector<long long>& arr) {
        int n = arr.size();
        st.resize(n, vector<long long>(25));
        log.resize(n + 2);
        build_log(n + 1);
        build(arr);
    }
    
    void build(vector<long long>& arr) {
        int n = arr.size();
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 25; j++) {
                int r = i + (1 << j) - 1;
                if (r >= n) break;
                if (j == 0) st[i][j] = arr[i];
                else st[i][j] = min(st[i][j - 1], st[i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
        if (a == 0) return b;
        return gcd(b % a, a);
    }
    
    long long query(int l, int r) {
        int w = r - l + 1;
        int power = log[w];
        return min(st[l][power], st[r - (1 << power) + 1][power]);
    }
    
    void build_log(int n) {
        log[1] = 0;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            log[i] = 1 + log[i / 2];
        }
    }
};
